secrets.name: BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
secrets.for: The scoring proxy's Brave Search key (01.2): a Worker secret of mood-read-proxy, never in the app

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.for: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (imported from .env.example: say what it is for)

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.for: R2 S3 access key id with Object Read and Write on the mood-read-catalog bucket; pnpm catalog:add uploads pieces and catalog.json with it (05.19)

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.for: R2 S3 secret access key paired with CLOUDFLARE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID; pnpm catalog:add signs its uploads to mood-read-catalog with it (05.19)

secrets.name: S3_API_ENDPOINT
secrets.for: The account's R2 S3 API endpoint (https://<account id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com) that pnpm catalog:add writes the mood-read-catalog bucket through (05.19)

secrets.name: SENTRY_ORG_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.for: SENTRY_ORG_AUTH_TOKEN (imported from .env.example: say what it is for)

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.for: The scoring proxy's OpenAI key (01.2): a Worker secret of mood-read-proxy, never in the app

secrets.name: PRESCORE_TOKEN
secrets.for: The owner's pre-scoring secret (05.10): a Worker secret of mood-read-proxy that `pnpm prescore` sends, locally and from the prescore GitHub job; never in the app
